title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-03 current SGA working record: SGA 6 complete and SGA 7-I through source page 236
description:
Public SGA working-translation record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record keeps the current reader-facing PDFs, source-scan witnesses, and compact source ZIPs for SGA translation/reconstruction work.

Status at a glance. SGA 5 high-fidelity source-checked stream is complete through printed page 484. SGA 6 strict source-checked French/English stream is complete through the original source scan, including terminological and notation indexes at source pages 693-702. SGA 7-I source-checked English/French working edition is current through source page 236. The existing SGA 3 English translation has been rebuilt to remove raw code-block typography, but is not yet a full mathematical re-typeset.

Latest update. Replaces the SGA 7-I page-184 packet with source-checked English/French cumulative readers through source page 236, the matching source-scan witness, and a compact SGA 7-I p236 source packet.
notes: Latest update replaces the SGA 7-I page-184 packet with source-checked English/French cumulative readers through source page 236 and a compact source packet for SGA 7-I p236 sources.
